label: MANUALLY SUPPLIED EVIDENCE — recorded by a reviewer from two public news reports. No metrics, no search volumes, no statistics.

provenance.method: Both pages were fetched on 2026-10-11 and read; every fact below appears in both reports unless marked with one source.

evidence.attribution: Khaleej Times — "Dubai Fitness Challenge opens registration for 2026 edition" (Bahni Bandyopadhyay, 1 Oct 2026)
Gulf News — "Dubai Fitness Challenge 2026: Registrations open for 30-day fitness drive" (Balaram Menon, 1 Oct 2026)

facts.statement: Registration for the 2026 Dubai Fitness Challenge opened on 1 October 2026.
It runs from 31 October to 29 November 2026 under the theme "What's Your 30x30?" — 30 minutes of activity a day for 30 days.
Flagship community events: Dubai Ride on 1 November, Dubai Run on 22 November and Dubai Yoga on 29 November 2026.
Registration is free on the official Dubai Fitness Challenge website.

note.relevanceRationale: A city-wide, month-long public activity drive in Dubai; relevant to businesses whose customers exercise or eat around exercise.
